'''Isaiah Dwayne Hicks''' (born July 24, 1994) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Leones de Ponce (basketball)|Leones de Ponce]] of the [[Baloncesto Superior Nacional]] (BSN). He played college basketball for the [[North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball|North Carolina Tar Heels]].

==High school and college career==
[[File:20130403 MCDAAG Isaiah Hicks dribbling.JPG|thumb|upright=0.9|Hicks in the [[2013 McDonald's All-American Boys Game]]]]
In his senior season at [[J. F. Webb High School]], he was named to the [[2013 McDonald's All-American Boys Game]] roster. He committed to [[North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball|North Carolina]].<ref name=MAA2T>{{cite web|url=http://www.mcdonaldsallamerican.com/aag/en/gamescenter/2013-Team.html|title=McDonald's All American® 2O13 Team|access-date=March 29, 2013|publisher=McDonaldsAllAmerican.com|archive-date=June 16, 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140616110733/http://www.mcdonaldsallamerican.com/aag/en/gamescenter/2013-Team.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>

At the conclusion of his junior season, he received the ACC's Sixth Man of the Year Award. He scored 17 points in UNC's 103–64 win over Texas Southern in the first round of the NCAA tournament, but afterward  averaged six points per game and did not score in double figures in UNC's last four games.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.newsobserver.com/sports/college/acc/unc/unc-now/article142342434.html#storylink=cpy|title=Isaiah Hicks returned to UNC for this moment, but Tar Heels wait for him to arrive|work=The News and Observer|access-date=April 3, 2017}}</ref> Hicks scored 13 points and had 9 rebounds in the Tar Heels victory over Gonzaga in the [[2017 NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship Game|2017 National Championship game]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.newsobserver.com/sports/college/acc/unc/unc-now/article142889569.html|title=A new ending for UNC's Isaiah Hicks, who saved his Final Four best for last|work=The News and Observer|access-date=April 5, 2017}}</ref>

==Professional career==
===New York Knicks (2017–2019)===
After going undrafted in the [[2017 NBA draft]], Hicks was signed by the [[Charlotte Hornets]] to their training camp roster. He was released on October 13, 2017, as one of the team's final preseason roster cuts.<ref>{{cite web|title=Charlotte Hornets Waive Four Players|url=http://www.nba.com/hornets/press-releases/charlotte-hornets-waive-four-players|website=NBA.com|access-date=October 14, 2017|date=October 13, 2017}}</ref>

On October 20, 2017, he signed  a [[two-way contract]] with the [[New York Knicks]] via their [[NBA G League]] affiliate the [[Westchester Knicks]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Knicks sign Isaiah Hicks to two-way contract|url=http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=21001|website=InsideHoops.com|access-date=October 21, 2017|date=October 20, 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171022041234/http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=21001|archive-date=October 22, 2017|url-status=dead}}</ref> Hicks made his NBA debut on February 8, 2018, against the [[Toronto Raptors]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.espn.com/nba/boxscore?gameId=400975558|title=Knicks vs. Raptors – Box Score|work=ESPN.com|date=February 8, 2018|access-date=April 28, 2018}}</ref> Hicks would sign a second two-way contract with the Knicks on July 3.<ref>{{cite web |title=Knicks Sign Isaiah Hicks and Allonzo Trier to Two-Way Contracts|url=https://www.nba.com/knicks/front-office-news/knicks-sign-isaiah-hicks-and-allonzo-trier-two-way-contracts|website=NBA.com|access-date=February 10, 2019|date=July 3, 2018}}</ref>

On June 30, 2019, Hicks signed with the Hornets for the summer league.<ref>{{cite web |title= UNC Basketball Alumni: Meeks, Hicks to play for Charlotte|url=https://keepingitheel.com/2019/06/30/unc-basketball-alumni-meeks-hicks-to-play-for-charlotte/ |publisher= Keeping it Heel |access-date= July 1, 2019}}</ref>

===International career (2019–present)===
On August 3, 2019, Hicks signed with Russian team [[BC Avtodor]] of the [[VTB United League]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Чемпион NCAA Айзейя Хикс перешел в "Автодор" |url=http://avtodor.ru/index.php/news-events/item/3678-avtodor_signed_isaiah_hicks |website=avtodor.ru |access-date=August 28, 2019 |language=ru-RU |date=August 3, 2019 |archive-date=August 4, 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190804131408/http://avtodor.ru/index.php/news-events/item/3678-avtodor_signed_isaiah_hicks |url-status=dead }}</ref> He averaged 12.8 points and 6.7 rebounds per game in the VTB League.<ref name=seoul/>

On July 16, 2020, Hicks signed with the [[Seoul Samsung Thunders]] of the [[Korean Basketball League]] (KBL).<ref name=seoul>{{cite web |title=Isaiah Hicks and Jessie Govan sign with Seoul Samsung Thunders |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/isaiah-hicks-and-jessie-govan-sign-with-seoul-samsung-thunders/ |website=Sportando |access-date=July 16, 2020 |date=July 16, 2020}}</ref> On June 15, 2021, he re-signed with the Seoul Samsung Thunders.<ref>{{cite web |title=아이제아 힉스, 서울 삼성과 재계약 “지난 시즌 기대 이상이었다” |url=https://jumpball.co.kr/news/newsview.php?ncode=1065585574922877 |website=점프볼 |access-date=December 4, 2024 |date=June 15, 2021}}</ref>

On July 1, 2022, Hicks signed with the [[San-en NeoPhoenix]] of the [[B.League]].<ref>{{cite web |title=2022-23シーズン 三遠ネオフェニックス ロスター決定のお知らせ |url=https://www.neophoenix.jp/news/detail/id=18293 |website=三遠ネオフェニックス |access-date=December 4, 2024 |date=July 1, 2022}}</ref>

On July 21, 2023, Hicks signed with the [[Daegu KOGAS Pegasus]] of the Korean Basketball League.<ref>{{cite web |title=위험 부담 줄인 가스공사, 삼성 출신 힉스·모스 영입 |url=https://jumpball.co.kr/news/newsview.php?ncode=1065601056442597 |website=점프볼 |access-date=December 4, 2024 |date=July 21, 2023}}</ref> In October 2023, he was replaced by [[Andrew Nicholson (basketball)|Andrew Nicholson]] after [[Achilles tendon rupture]].<ref>{{cite web |title=[용병닷컴통신]가스공사, 니콜슨 영입 추진...힉스 시즌아웃 |url=https://jumpball.co.kr/news/newsview.php?ncode=1065624344620679 |website=점프볼 |access-date=December 4, 2024 |date=October 16, 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=‘힉스 대타’ 니콜슨, 시즌 대체 공시…남은 건 등록 절차 |url=https://jumpball.co.kr/news/newsview.php?ncode=1065608378554335 |website=점프볼 |access-date=December 4, 2024 |date=October 19, 2023}}</ref>

On June 20, 2024, Hicks signed with the [[Seoul SK Knights]] of the Korean Basketball League.<ref>{{cite web |title='컴백' 힉스, 붉은 기사단 유니폼 입는다…SK와 계약 완료 |url=https://jumpball.co.kr/news/newsview.php?ncode=1065597319105809 |website=점프볼 |access-date=December 4, 2024 |date=June 20, 2024}}</ref>
